title: Producer Retention Playbook Snippets
scope: Use with attrition_scorer heuristic risk bands and factor contributions.
disclaimer: The attrition score is a deterministic heuristic, not trained ML and not a prediction guarantee.

low: Maintain standard cadence and continue monitoring production and engagement signals.
Recognize positive performance during regular producer reviews.
medium: Schedule a check-in within 10 business days.
Review recent production trend, portal usage, service tickets, and complaint history.
Offer enablement or workflow support tied to the top factor contributions.
high: Assign a retention owner and contact the producer within 3 business days.
Prepare a remediation plan for service issues, complaint themes, or missed target drivers.
Escalate compensation, appetite, or service blockers to the appropriate leader.
critical: Open an executive retention case within 1 business day.
Validate all factor data before outreach and avoid implying automated prediction.
Create a documented recovery plan with owner, deadline, and follow-up cadence.

factor_guidance.production_trend: Compare current and prior period production; separate market seasonality from producer-specific decline.
factor_guidance.tenure: For early-tenure producers, confirm onboarding, appetite education, and quoting workflow support.
factor_guidance.login_frequency: Low portal usage may indicate workflow friction, missing access, or reduced engagement.
factor_guidance.complaint_count: Review complaint root cause and confirm remediation ownership.
factor_guidance.open_service_tickets: Prioritize stale or blocking service cases before retention outreach.
